theater: 佩滕湖區與佩滕巴通河谷

battle.name: 對努恩·烏卓爾·查克的戰爭
battle.theater: 佩滕湖區與佩滕巴通河谷
battle.brief: 公元677年，卡拉克穆爾聯同多斯皮拉斯大軍攻入佩滕湖畔的都城蒂卡爾，國王努恩·烏卓爾·查克退守敗北；679年他反攻多斯皮拉斯又遭挫敗，戰事以多斯皮拉斯立碑記功收場。卡面的秦連弩從未到過中美洲，此役的投射主力是擲矛器配木矛，近戰靠嵌黑曜石刃的木劍，攻城用木梯與火攻。

kit.name: 秦連弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，一踩一發。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 這場戰爭是古典期瑪雅低地城邦體系裡的一次霸權轉移，交戰雙方都不是統一國家，而是各自獨立的城邦政治體。敗方是蒂卡爾：以佩滕湖東岸的都城蒂卡爾為核心，王權由神聖君主（ajaw）掌握，王室以文字圖形記錄戰功，祭祀與曆算歸王室祭司團隊，兵員沒有常備軍制，靠城邦抽調的菁英戰團（美洲豹、黑豹等戰團）與村落民兵湊成，武器與糧秣各自備辦，進攻則要靠城邦之間的盟邦與附庸網絡撐住。勝方是一個聯盟：卡拉克穆爾，即今日墨西哥坎佩切州一帶、低地西側的另一強國，首都位於霍科帕沼澤地帶，由尤克努姆·切恩二世（Yuknoom Ch'een II，又名 K'inich Yax K'uk' Mo'）執政；多斯皮拉斯則是蒂卡爾於629年分封出去的支系城邦，位於今日瓜地瑪拉佩滕省佩滕巴通河谷，由巴萊赫·錢·卡維爾統率，他自648年兵敗被俘，到672年被逐出，長期寄居卡拉克穆爾並靠其扶持復國。兩城的統治模式幾乎相同：神王加祭司，沒有常備兵源，沒有路綫制度與後勤機構，戰爭勝負取決於誰能在一季之內把菁英隊伍連同隨軍勞役搬到敵前。
countriesEn: This war was a transfer of hegemony inside the city-state system of the Late Classic Maya lowlands. Neither side was a unified state; both were independent city-state polities. The loser was Tikal: a polity built around the city of Tikal on the eastern shore of Lake Peten, where kingship was held by a divine ruler (ajaw), dynastic achievements were carved in hieroglyphic text, ritual and calendrics belonged to the royal priestly corps, and there was no standing army of any kind. Fighters were drawn from the elite orders, the jaguar and black-jaguar societies, and from village levies, each supplying his own weapons and rations, while the whole undertaking was carried by a web of allied and subordinate towns. The winning side was a coalition. Calakmul, the rival power in the western lowlands of what is now the state of Campeche in Mexico, had its capital in the wetlands around Xookopa and was ruled by Yuknoom Ch'een II, also called K'inich Yax K'uk' Mo'. Dos Pilas was a cadet town founded by Tikal itself in AD 629 in the Petexbatun region of the Peten department of Guatemala, under Balaj Chan K'awiil, who had been beaten and taken captive in 648, driven out again in 672, and who for long years lived in Calakmul and owed his restoration to it. Both cities were governed in almost the same way: a sacred king backed by priests, no standing manpower, no system of lines of march and no logistical establishment, so that the outcome of a war came down to who could move an elite corps and its burden train into the enemy front within a single season.
people: 點名的人分三處。蒂卡爾一方是國王努恩·烏卓爾·查克（Nuun Ujol Chaak，約662年至734年在位），這場以他為對象的戰爭就發生在他治下；正是他在672年攻下多斯皮拉斯、逐走巴萊赫·錢·卡維爾，構成了本役的起點。蒂卡爾的菁英將領、戰團首領與隨軍書記沒有留下名字，這是瑪雅史料的常態，勝方只刻自己的功業，敗方的損失只能從後來城市的廢墟推想。多斯皮拉斯一方是巴萊赫·錢·卡維爾（B'alaj Chan K'awiil，約648年即位，692年後仍在位），他在648年被卡拉克穆爾打敗俘虜，隨後被卡拉克穆爾扶植回國作為附庸；672年蒂卡爾攻勢再起，他被迫帶著家人流亡到卡拉克穆爾，流亡五年的結束日，恰好就是卡拉克穆爾記下對蒂卡爾一次勝利的同一天；679年他再勝蒂卡爾，多斯皮拉斯因此立二號碑記功。卡拉克穆爾的君主尤克努姆·切恩二世是這盤棋背後的手，他出兵支持多斯皮拉斯，等於用附庸的刀去切蒂卡爾；多斯皮拉斯後來的將領烏查安·金·巴蘭在705年再度打敗蒂卡爾並俘走其君主，說明這一系的戰爭技藝在整個區域延續了數十年。十六世紀的西班牙編年史者迪耶戈·德·蘭達與弗朗西斯科·希門內斯留下的是馬雅人彼此攻伐、勝負不定的總述；1696年總督迪耶戈·德·基奧下令、方濟各會修士執行的蒂卡爾神廟摧毀，把這些石刻大半化為碎屑。現代的重建者同樣要點名：塔蒂安娜·普羅斯庫里亞科夫以銘文串起蒂卡爾王表，威廉·科伊領軍的佩滕盆地考古計畫自1956年起在蒂卡爾發掘，亞瑟·德馬雷斯特與胡安·安東尼奧·巴爾德斯自1989年起在多斯皮拉斯清理，替這場戰爭補回器物與人骨兩頭的證據。
peopleEn: The named figures fall into three groups. On the Tikal side stands the king Nuun Ujol Chaak, who ruled from about AD 662 to 734; the war against him took place in his reign, and it was his capture of Dos Pilas in 672, with the expulsion of Balaj Chan K'awiil, that set this conflict in motion. The elite commanders, order leaders and scribes of Tikal left no names behind, which is the normal condition of Maya sources: the victor carves his own deeds, while the loser's losses can only be inferred from the ruins of the city in later centuries. On the Dos Pilas side stands Balaj Chan K'awiil, who took the throne about AD 648 and was still alive after 692. He was beaten and captured by Calakmul in 648 and then reinstalled by Calakmul as a client ruler; when Tikal struck again in 672 he was forced into exile with his family, and the day his five-year exile ended was the very day on which Calakmul recorded a success over Tikal. In 679 he beat Tikal once more, and Dos Pilas raised its Stela 2 to record the deed. Yuknoom Ch'een II, ruler of Calakmul, was the hand behind the whole board: he sent troops to support Dos Pilas, using a client as the knife against Tikal. Later the Dos Pilas commander Ucha'an K'in B'alam defeated Tikal again in 705 and carried off its lord, showing that this line of warcraft carried on for decades across the region. The Spanish chroniclers Diego de Landa and Francisco Ximenez, writing in the sixteenth century, could only summarize that the Maya attacked one another and that victory was uncertain; in 1696 Governor Diego de Quio ordered the destruction of the temples of Tikal, carried out by Franciscan friars, which reduced most of these carved stones to rubble. The modern reconstructors must be named as well: Tatiana Proskouriakoff used the inscriptions to reconstruct the dynastic sequence of Tikal, William Coe led the Peten Basin Archaeological Project at Tikal from 1956, and Arthur Demarest and Juan Antonio Valdes worked at Dos Pilas from 1989, supplying for this war the evidence of artefacts and of human bone.
kits: 卡面上這件秦連弩（Repeating crossbow，約公元前200年）從未出現在中美洲，與本役毫無牽連。它在中國的價值在於弩機把拉力存起來、一踩一發，連發的好處在守城，把攻城的人壓在牆外，而這恰恰是本役最缺乏的東西：瑪雅低地沒有機械弩，也沒有任何重複投射的裝置，直到十六世紀西班牙人帶來弩與火繩槍才第一次出現。真正扮演壓制攻城者角色的，是蒂卡爾城牆與臺地的高度、木柵與屋頂火攻，以及擲矛器（atlatl）加輕矛所形成的連續投射面。瑪雅兵器可分五層：一、近戰，鑲黑曜石或燧石刃的木劍（macuahuitl）與石斧，須雙手揮砍；二、投射，擲矛器配細長木矛最為普遍，另有短弓與箭、石彈投石索；三、防護，棉絮夾層的棉甲（ichcahuipilli）外罩獸皮，木框蒙皮綴羽的圓盾（chictli），頭戴硬木或獸皮頭套；四、攻城，木梯、繩索、破門斧與火攻草束，建築多為木構茅頂，一經點燃難以撲救；五、後勤，瑪雅沒有馭獸，糧秣、矛束與繩梯全靠人背，渡河改用獨木舟，主食是玉米、豆類、巧克力與鹹魚。黑曜石來自埃爾查亞爾與伊什特佩克等高地礦點，翡翠來自莫塔瓜河谷，鹽來自加勒比海岸，貿易品與附庸貢賦的流動才是城邦聯盟真正的黏合劑。
kitsEn: The kit on the card, a Chinese repeating crossbow of about 200 BC, never reached Mesoamerica and has nothing to do with this campaign. Its value in China lay in the trigger mechanism storing the drawn power so that one step of the foot loosed one shot, and in siege work that repeat fire could hold attackers against the wall, which is precisely what this campaign most lacked: there was no mechanical crossbow anywhere in the Maya lowlands and no repeating device of any kind, and none appeared until the Spaniards brought crossbows and matchlock guns in the sixteenth century. What actually did the job of pinning attackers down was the height of Tikal's walls and terraces, wooden palisades, fire set against the roofs, and the continuous sheet of fire thrown by atlatls and light darts. Maya arms can be sorted into five layers. First, close combat: wooden clubs with obsidian or chert blades inserted, the macuahuitl, and stone axes, all swung with two hands. Second, missile weapons: the atlatl with its slender dart was the commonest, alongside short bows and arrows and stone-pellet slings. Third, protection: quilted cotton armour, the ichcahuipilli, worn over fur, wooden-framed hide-covered round shields, the chictli, and hardwood or hide headgear. Fourth, siege work: wooden ladders, ropes, axes for breaching doors and bundles of burning grass, since most buildings were wooden with thatched roofs and once alight were almost impossible to save. Fifth, logistics: the Maya kept no draft animals, so grain, bundles of darts and rope ladders all went on human backs, rivers were crossed by dugout canoe, and the staple food was maize, beans, cacao and salt fish. Obsidian came from highland sources such as El Chayal and Ixtepeque, jade from the Motagua valley, salt from the Caribbean coast, and the flow of trade goods and of tribute from dependent towns was the real glue of the city-state alliances.
tactics: 瑪雅戰爭有一套相對固定的程序。第一步是定日：祭司兼天文官依金星曆與長紀曆算出星戰日期，出征以星戰（star war）之名公告，日期往往落在卡敦或通克期的結束日，士兵相信勝敗由神明裁決，日期一旦定下就不能更改。第二步是行軍：隊伍由持矛的菁英戰團開路，後隨擲矛手、弓手與投石手，糧食由勞役隊背負，渡水靠獨木舟，沒有騎兵，速度受河道與雨季泥濘限制，蒂卡爾到多斯皮拉斯的直線距離約六十公里，步兵隊伍要走五到七天。第三步是接戰：木盾相接結成正面，擲矛手在散兵線上反覆投射，弓手壓制對方射手，真正造成大量殺傷的是黑曜石木劍，砍完還得把刃拔出來。第四步是破城與收尾：突擊多靠夜襲、火攻與短時間猛攻，而不是長期圍城，圍城更多依靠封鎖水道與斷糧，城破之後是獻祭與羞辱俘虜，割喉、取血、剖心，首級堆成堆，戰果則以石柱與神廟門楣的銘文記下。本役的特殊之處在於攻守易位：677年是卡拉克穆爾與多斯皮拉斯的聯軍攻入蒂卡爾，679年反過來由蒂卡爾攻多斯皮拉斯卻被打退，兩次都以星戰為名、以血池與頭堆作結，城市之間的權力就這樣在幾年之內翻了一次面。
tacticsEn: Maya warfare followed a fairly fixed sequence. The first step was to fix the date: the priest who doubled as astronomer computed the day of the star war from the Venus table and the Long Count, and the campaign was announced under the name of a star war; the date usually fell on the end of a katun or a tun, because the soldiers believed that victory was adjudicated by the gods, and once a day was named it could not be changed. The second step was the march: the line was led by elite spear orders, followed by atlatl throwers, archers and slingers, while grain was carried by burden parties and rivers were crossed by dugout canoe. There were no cavalry, and speed was limited by rivers and by mud in the rainy season. The direct distance from Tikal to Dos Pilas is about sixty kilometres, five to seven days on foot for an infantry column. The third step was the clash: wooden shields met to form a front, atlatl throwers worked the open ground with repeated volleys, archers covered the enemy shooters, and the real slaughter came from the obsidian-edged clubs, which had to be twisted out of the wound after the blow. The fourth step was the storming and the finish: attacks relied on night raids, fire and short concentrated rushes rather than on long siege, and investment was more often a matter of closing the water routes and cutting off the grain; once a city fell came the sacrifice and the humiliation of captives, the throat cut, blood drawn, the chest opened, the heads piled up, and the results carved in the text of stelae and temple lintels. What is unusual about this campaign is the reversal of roles: in 677 the coalition of Calakmul and Dos Pilas entered Tikal, and in 679 Tikal in turn attacked Dos Pilas and was beaten back; both were fought as star wars, both ended with blood pools and piles of heads, and in a few years the balance of power between the cities turned over completely.
data: 本役的年代有兩條硬刻度可以對準。其一是蒂卡爾在672年奪回多斯皮拉斯的年份，長紀曆9.12.0.0.0即公元672年6月29日，正是努恩·烏卓爾·查克擒下多斯皮拉斯的年頭；同樣的算式給出9.13.0.0.0，約合公元692年3月，蒂卡爾王宮一帶被焚的記載出現於此一時期，學者普遍把這次焚燒視為都城被占之後的重奪與祭祀儀式。戰爭本身的年代區間落在677至679年，679年多斯皮拉斯二號碑立起，記下星戰、血池與頭堆，被多斯皮拉斯一方當作戰爭結束的標誌。數字上必須有節制：勝方從不記錄敵軍的損耗，蒂卡爾方面的兵員傷亡至今沒有任何可核的數目，只能從城市規模推測。蒂卡爾在鼎盛期的人口約四萬至五萬，核心區面積約一平方公里，多斯皮拉斯的核心區也約一平方公里，兩城相距約六十公里，糧秣全靠人力背負，這段距離的補給線就足以拖垮一支遠征隊。整批星戰銘文共記十三場，橫跨562至781年，其中約七成對應金星昏星初現，而且沒有一場落在九月中至十月下旬的收穫期。戰後蒂卡爾約一百二十年沒有留下紀念碑，九世紀才重新密集立碑；學者估計九至十世紀南部低地的人口下降約四至五成。
dataEn: Two hard reference points let the dates of this campaign be fixed. The first is the year in which Tikal took Dos Pilas back, 672, when the Long Count 9.12.0.0.0 corresponds to 29 June AD 672, the year in which Nuun Ujol Chaak captured Dos Pilas. The same reckoning gives 9.13.0.0.0 as about March AD 692, and the record of the burning of the royal precinct of Tikal falls in that period; scholars generally read this burning as the ritual that accompanied the recovery of the capital after its occupation. The campaign itself belongs to the span AD 677 to 679, and in 679 Dos Pilas raised Stela 2, recording a star war, a pool of blood and a pile of heads, which the Dos Pilas side treated as the conclusion of the war. On numbers, restraint is necessary: the victors never recorded the enemy's losses, and no verifiable count of Tikal's casualties survives; only the scale of the cities allows estimates. Tikal in its prime held perhaps forty to fifty thousand people and covered about one square kilometre in its core area, and the core of Dos Pilas was of a comparable size, the two lying about sixty kilometres apart, with all grain carried on human backs, so that a supply line of that length alone could exhaust an expeditionary army. The whole corpus of star war inscriptions records thirteen campaigns between AD 562 and 781; about seventy per cent of them fall on the first evening appearance of Venus, and not one falls in the harvest season between mid-September and late October. After this war Tikal raised no memorial for about a hundred and twenty years and only resumed dense stela setting in the ninth century; estimates put the fall of population in the southern lowlands during the ninth and tenth centuries at forty to fifty per cent.
cause: 起因是多線糾纏在一起的。第一層是王位糾葛：多斯皮拉斯本來是蒂卡爾於629年分封出去的支系，創建者巴萊赫·錢·卡維爾一直自認是蒂卡爾王位的正統繼承人，648年他被卡拉克穆爾打敗俘虜，卻在卡拉克穆爾扶持下重返王位，等於在蒂卡爾背後插了一支敵軍；672年努恩·烏卓爾·查克攻下多斯皮拉斯、把他逐往卡拉克穆爾流亡，等於逼卡拉克穆爾直接出手。第二層是霸權之爭：卡拉克穆爾與蒂卡爾長期爭奪佩滕與佩滕巴通兩區的商路、水源與盟邦歸屬，埃爾查亞爾黑曜石、莫塔瓜翡翠與海岸鹽的流向就是權力的流向，附庸與盟邦需要一次公開的勝負來重新排序。第三層是儀式與時序：星戰要挑在金星曆站得住的日子出征，出兵本身就是向全區宣告神權裁決，雙方事後都無法否認。第四層是農業與氣候：八世紀初南部低地反覆乾旱，玉米產量下降，出征集中於乾季，糧道與水源的爭奪因此更形激烈。這場戰爭並非某個君主一時衝動，而是兩座城邦的資源、王位合法性與神權程序同時繃到斷點的結果。
causeEn: The causes were entangled on several levels. The first is a dispute of dynastic legitimacy. Dos Pilas had been a cadet branch granted out by Tikal itself in AD 629, and its founder Balaj Chan K'awiil always held himself to be the rightful successor to the Tikal throne; when Calakmul beat him and took him captive in 648, it then put him back on his throne as its own client, which amounted to planting an enemy army in Tikal's rear. When Nuun Ujol Chaak took Dos Pilas in 672 and drove him into exile at Calakmul, he forced Calakmul to act in person. The second is the contest for hegemony. Calakmul and Tikal had long competed for the trade routes, the water and the allegiance of the towns of the Peten and Petexbatun zones; the flow of El Chayal obsidian, Motagua jade and coastal salt was the flow of power itself, and client towns and allies needed a public result in order to rearrange the order. The third is ritual and timing: a star war had to be launched on a day that the Venus table could justify, and the act of marching out was itself a declaration before the whole region that the gods had adjudicated, something neither side could afterwards deny. The fourth is agriculture and climate: repeated drought in the southern lowlands in the early eighth century cut the maize yield, campaigns were concentrated in the dry season, and the struggle over supply lines and water became correspondingly fiercer. This war was not a monarch's sudden whim; it was the result of the resources, the legitimacy of succession and the ritual calendar of two city-states all reaching breaking point at once.
impact: 直接後果是低地政治版圖整個翻面。677年之後蒂卡爾失去霸權地位，王室停止立碑，核心區淪為廢墟，住民外流或淪為附庸，過去一百年累積的紀念建築群有相當一部分被拆去取石；多斯皮拉斯這類從蒂卡爾分出來的支系城邦第一次靠自己的碑銘站到歷史前線，679年的勝利碑表明它已能獨立在區域政治中扮演主角。間接後果是整個古典期的崩解：卡拉克穆爾在695年被蒂卡爾反敗，七〇五年蒂卡爾再度被多斯皮拉斯的將領烏查安·金·巴蘭打敗、國王被俘，七六一年多斯皮拉斯因屬地反叛而廢棄，連續的翻轉說明這幾十年並非任何一方設計的長期秩序，而是一連串斷裂；學者把南部低地九至十世紀的人口銳減與城邦沉默歸因於戰亂、乾旱與流行病的疊加，戰爭是其中最直接的一項壓力來源。對後世而言，這段歷史是考古學與銘文學重建瑪雅政治的第一手材料：蒂卡爾、多斯皮拉斯、卡拉克穆爾三城同處一張網，誰是宗主、誰是附庸，全靠碑上留下的日期、俘獲與獻祭記錄來判定。
impactEn: The immediate consequence was that the political map of the lowlands turned over. After 677 Tikal lost its position of supremacy, its kings stopped setting monuments, its core decayed into ruin, and its people either dispersed or fell away as dependents; a considerable part of the commemorative buildings accumulated over a century was broken up for building stone. A cadet polity like Dos Pilas, spun off from Tikal, stood in the front rank of regional history for the first time on the strength of its own carved stelae, and the victory stele of 679 shows it already able to act as a principal power in its own right. The indirect consequence was the unraveling of the whole Classic period: Calakmul was beaten back by Tikal in 695, Tikal was defeated once more in 705 by the Dos Pilas commander Ucha'an K'in B'alam and its lord was carried off, and in 761 Dos Pilas was abandoned when its dependent sites rebelled. This run of reversals shows that those decades were not a long order designed by anyone but a chain of fractures. Scholars attribute the collapse of population and the silence of the southern lowland city-states in the ninth and tenth centuries to war, drought and epidemic disease in combination, and this war was the most direct single source of that pressure. For later scholarship the episode is first-hand material for reconstructing Maya politics from archaeology and inscriptions: Tikal, Dos Pilas and Calakmul all sat on one network, and whether a town was overlord or client is settled entirely by the dates, the captures and the sacrificial records left on its monuments.
result: 本役的結局是三次勝負交錯，最後以多斯皮拉斯宣告終戰收場。677年，卡拉克穆爾聯同歸附的多斯皮拉斯大軍攻入蒂卡爾，蒂卡爾敗北，國王努恩·烏卓爾·查克退守城內，都城陷入敵手控制；多斯皮拉斯方面則在同一天把流亡五年的巴萊赫·錢·卡維爾迎回王位，藉此向全區宣告自己不再是蒂卡爾的附庸，而是有卡拉克穆爾撐腰的獨立城邦。679年，蒂卡爾集結兵力反攻多斯皮拉斯，卻在佩滕巴通河谷再遭挫敗，多斯皮拉斯大勝而歸，立二號碑記下星戰與血池、頭堆的戰果，並以此作為這場戰爭的了結；不過雙方都沒有因此取得決定性的優勢，疆界大致回到戰前。多斯皮拉斯隨後在695年的敗於蒂卡爾、705年再度打敗蒂卡爾之間左右逢源，到761年終於隨佩滕巴通地區的普遍反叛而一同廢棄；蒂卡爾則要到大約692年才在查斯瓦·錢·卡維爾一世手上收復都城，之後又停頓百餘年才恢復立碑。
resultEn: The outcome ran through three exchanges of victory and defeat and closed with Dos Pilas declaring the war over. In 677 the army of Calakmul, accompanied by its client Dos Pilas, entered Tikal: Tikal was beaten, the king Nuun Ujol Chaak fell back inside the city, and the capital passed under enemy control. On the same day Dos Pilas welcomed Balaj Chan K'awiil back from five years of exile, announcing to the whole region that it was no longer a client of Tikal but an independent city-state with Calakmul behind it. In 679 Tikal mustered its forces and counter-attacked Dos Pilas, only to be checked again in the Petexbatun valley; Dos Pilas returned in triumph, raised Stela 2 to set down the star war, the pool of blood and the pile of heads, and treated that as the settlement of the war. Even so, neither side gained a decisive advantage, and the frontier returned roughly to where it had been. Dos Pilas then profited between its defeat by Tikal in 695 and its own victory over Tikal in 705, until in 761 it too was abandoned in the general revolt of the Petexbatun region; Tikal, for its part, did not recover its capital until about 692 under Jasaw Chan K'awiil I, and then paused for another century before it began raising monuments once more.
